# SIR: базовый прогон (дискретно-событийная модель)

```{julia}
import Pkg
Pkg.activate("/home/dabakharev/work/study/2026-1/2026-1==study-simulation-modeling/2026-1-study-simulation-modeling/labs/lab08/project")
using DrWatson

include("/home/dabakharev/work/study/2026-1/2026-1==study-simulation-modeling/2026-1-study-simulation-modeling/labs/lab08/project/src/sir_model.jl")
using Random, StatsPlots, DataFrames, CSV

ENV["GKSwstype"] = "100"

script_name = "sir_des"
mkpath(plotsdir(script_name))
mkpath(datadir(script_name))
```

## Параметры

```{julia}
tmax = 40.0
u0 = [990, 10, 0]
p = [0.05, 10.0, 0.25]

Random.seed!(1234)
```

## Запуск

```{julia}
des_model = MakeSIRModel(u0, p)
activate(des_model)
sir_run(des_model, tmax)
data_des = out(des_model)
```

## Сохранение

```{julia}
CSV.write(datadir(script_name, "sir_des.csv"), data_des)
```

## Визуализация

```{julia}
@df data_des plot(
    :t, [:S :I :R],
    labels=["S" "I" "R"],
    xlab="Время", ylab="Численность",
    title="Дискретно-событийная SIR модель")
savefig(plotsdir(script_name, "sir_des.png"))

println("Готово! График: ", plotsdir(script_name, "sir_des.png"))
```
